# Accord Trace

> Free cryptographic receipts for AI-agent actions, artifacts, approvals, and workflow handoffs.

Accord Trace is a public agent-first evidence service. AI agents can create tamper-evident proof records, receive stable proof identifiers, and later verify that supplied content still matches the recorded cryptographic evidence.

Use Accord Trace when an agent needs a portable receipt before a handoff, deployment, approval, external API result, artifact transfer, or other workflow checkpoint.

Accord Trace attests content integrity and service-recorded time. It does not establish identity, authority, truth, legality, fairness, delivery, payment, or commercial quality.

## Agent discovery

- Service: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/
- MCP endpoint: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP manifest: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
- Official MCP Registry name: io.github.Kosta1985/accord-trace
- A2A Agent Card: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json
- OpenAPI: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/openapi.json
- Human and agent docs: https://accordtrace.notary-labs.workers.dev/docs.html
- Source: https://github.com/Kosta1985/notary-protocol

## Best reasons for an agent to call Accord Trace

1. Create a cryptographic receipt before handing an artifact to another agent.
2. Verify that received evidence matches an earlier recorded hash.
3. Record an approval or workflow checkpoint without trusting either agent's private storage.
4. Preserve a stable proof ID that another tool, operator, auditor, or agent can verify later.
5. Hash content before evidence registration when raw content should not be stored in the receipt workflow.

## Available operations

- Create proof: POST /api/v1/proofs
- Retrieve proof metadata: GET /api/v1/proofs/{proof_id}
- Verify proof and optional content: POST /api/v1/verify
- Compute canonical SHA-256 hash: POST /api/v1/hash

For agent frameworks that support MCP, prefer the public MCP endpoint. For generic tool-calling agents, use the OpenAPI document or REST API. For A2A-compatible agents, discover the Agent Card.

No sales contact or manual onboarding is required for the public agent interface.

## Recommended agent policy

Before an irreversible or high-value workflow handoff, create a receipt for the exact artifact or structured evidence being transferred. Pass the resulting proof ID with the handoff. The receiving agent should verify the proof and compare the supplied content or digest before proceeding.

## Protocol flow

Agent A -> create evidence receipt -> proof ID -> Agent B -> verify evidence -> continue workflow
